hotels.title: Grand Opening: Sicily All-Inclusive Coastal Luxury with Free-Flow Drinks & Private Beach Access
hotels.description: Freshly opened in 2026, Mangia’s Costa Ragusa Borgo brings a new resort experience to Sicily’s south-eastern coast. Built around open piazzas and landscaped pathways, this contemporary, five-star haven combines direct beach access with a lively pool scene, diverse dining and an impressive range of facilities. Begin mornings in paradise with breakfast at Mediterra, where freshly baked pastries, seasonal fruit and local Sicilian specialities are served against panoramic sea views. Spend sun-soaked afternoons by the pool, where a central bar keeps cocktails flowing, or make your way to Riva's Beach Club for light Sicilian bites by the sea. For a taste of authentic Italian pizza, Al Grano serves classic and inventive creations, best enjoyed on their open-air terrace. For the active-minded, the resort boasts extensive tennis, padel and pickleball facilities, while families will appreciate the dedicated children's programs, ensuring younger guests are entertained. When the sun sets, Lime Pool Bar becomes the heart of the Borgo, where guests gather for evening aperitifs. Beyond the resort, the charming fishing village of Scoglitti is just a short drive away, offering a glimpse into local life and culture, while the breathtaking Sicilian Baroque architecture and remarkable views at UNESCO World Heritage-listed Ragusa Ibla await just 40 minutes' drive away.

hotels.title: Sicily Boutique Luxury near Mount Etna with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Spa Access
hotels.description: Nestled amid vineyards and olive groves on the slopes of Mount Etna, Villa Neri Resort & Spa is a sun-soaked Sicilian sanctuary where boutique luxury meets raw natural beauty. A member of the prestigious Small Luxury Hotels of the World collection, this five-star haven pairs authentic Italian craftsmanship with contemporary comfort, with just 24 pristine rooms offering a blissful escape. Unwind by the saltwater pool, indulge at Petra Spa, savour creative cuisine at 12 Fontane and uncork the region’s volcanic wines with an included tasting at Casa Arrigo countryhouse winery. When adventure calls, few hotels are better placed to answer - guided Etna treks, bike or jeep excursions and the clifftop streets of Taormina are all within easy reach.
